jobs.title: NERA Senior Consultant/Director – Energy
jobs.description:
Company:
NERA

Description:

Since 1961, NERA ( https://www.nera.com ) has provided unparalleled guidance on the most important market, legal, and regulatory questions of the day. Our work has shaped industries and policy around the world. Our field-leading experts and deep experience allow us to provide rigorous analysis, reliable expert testimony, and data-powered policy recommendations for the world’s leading law firms and corporations as well as regulators and governments. Our experience, integrity, and economic ingenuity mean clients can depend on us in the face of their biggest economic and financial challenges.

We are currently looking for an intellectually curious, independent-minded team player with an entrepreneurial spirit to join our Energy line of business as a Senior Consultant or Director.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a global firm that uses quantitative methods to analyze energy and transportation markets, evaluate regulation and competition, and conduct analyses that will be used in energy and transportation regulatory and commercial disputes. Ideal candidates will bring experience across key verticals such as electricity, O&G, and renewables, and have a broad regulatory/litigation background.

Qualified candidates will have 6-8+ years of experience and be experts in supporting energy clients on high-value matters. They should have experience testifying, leading projects, and managing P&L. They will operate independently and build and run a “microbusiness” inside a broader platform. Candidates should be interested in, and passionate about, owning client relationships and delivering high-quality work.

NERA will provide you with opportunities for growth and professional development—progressing from a seasoned senior to expert—and the ability to work across a broad range of industries, including mining, infrastructure, and energy. NERA offers a flat structure—Partners own P&L, manage teams, lead client work, and foster a collegial environment with strong collaboration across the firm. NERA has world-class support staff—PhDs, top-tier STEM talent, and significant project management and analytical resources—as well as strong brand recognition in regulatory and litigation arenas.

The applicable base salary for this role is $225,000 – $275,000 per year.​
​
The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, and education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, 401K savings and other retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.​

NERA’s clients value our ability to apply and communicate state-of-the-art approaches clearly and convincingly, our commitment to delivering unbiased findings, and our reputation for quality and independence. Our clients rely on the integrity and skills of our unparalleled team of economists, backed by the resources and reliability of one of the world’s largest economic consultancies. NERA serves clients from more than 25 offices across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. NERA provides an environment in which dedication to client and project success, individual professional development, and fun are at the forefront. The work environment is collegial, and there are numerous opportunities to learn and connect with staff at all levels.

#NERA

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit corporate.marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

As part of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) Management Consulting, NERA Economic Consulting (http://www.nera.com/) is a global firm of experts dedicated to applying economic, finance, and quantitative principles to complex business and legal challenges. For half a century, NERA's economists have been creating strategies, studies, reports, expert testimony, and policy recommendations for government authorities and the world's leading law firms and corporations. We bring academic rigor, objectivity, and real world industry experience to bear on issues arising from competition, regulation, public policy, strategy, finance, and litigation.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, veteran status (including protected veterans), or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by contacting reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

jobs.title: NERA Consultant (New York City)
jobs.description:
Company:
NERA

Description:

National Economic Research Associates, Inc. is seeking candidates for the following full-time positions based in the New York, NY office (A hybrid work schedule may be permitted within a commutable distance from the worksite, in accordance with company policies.):

Consultant : (Multiple Positions)

We will count on you to:

Conduct economic, statistical, and financial modeling to address a wide range of complex challenges within the Securities and Finance and Mass Torts Practice. Evaluate issues related to class certification, price impact, loss causation, materiality, and damages in securities class action cases. Carry out quantitative and qualitative analyses of economic trends concerning alleged violations of securities laws, ERISA regulations, and contract breaches. Examine historical data and perform forecasting to assess potential risks associated with product liability and mass tort claims. Apply advanced statistical techniques to analyze participation patterns in mass tort cases. Value start-up companies, established businesses, and sophisticated financial instruments. Develop econometric models using cutting-edge statistical methods, extensive datasets, and programming tools. Stay informed on business and financial sector developments by reviewing financial publications, investment banking research, public databases, trade journals, and proprietary sources. Keep current with the latest academic research in finance, economics, and statistics to enhance daily work. Prepare reports covering broad economic trends, finance and statistical issues, and specific client business challenges. Engage in meetings with clients, external experts, auditors, boards of directors, insurers, and other stakeholders, and contribute to business development activities alongside senior team members. This position has no dedicated full-time direct reports but will plan, direct, and supervise the work performed by junior staff on a project-by-project basis.

What you need to have :

Must have a Master's degree or foreign equivalent in Economics, Public Policy, or a related field plus three (3) years of experience in the position offered or a related position. In the alternative, employer will accept a Bachelor's degree in Economics, Public Policy, or a related field plus five (5) years of experience in the position offered or a related position. Must have three (3) years (or five (5) years with a Bachelor's) of experience with all of the following: Utilizing R and Python programming languages to clean datasets as well as develop and validate econometric models including linear regression and time series analyses; Constructing and interpreting confidence intervals for model output; Performing statistical forecasts by analyzing seasonality, long term trends, and correlations; Designing, developing, and debugging complex Excel VBA macros to automate repetitive data processing tasks enhancing operational efficiency; Applying INDEX-MATCH, INDIRECT, OFFSET, and SUMIFS functions to execute intricate data manipulation and cleaning; Leveraging Excel's advanced charting and tabulation capabilities to visualize data and generate insights; Conducting in-depth fundamental research on publicly listed entities by systematically analyzing SEC filings including 10-K and 10-Qs, equity research reports, and market news, and supplementing with third-party datasets to generate comprehensive company profiles; Using Factiva, FactSet, Bloomberg LP, and S&P Capital IQ to collect financial filings and news articles; Performing rigorous valuation analyses of both public and private firms by constructing discounted cash flow (DCF) models, calculating trading multiples, and estimating discount rates through application of Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) and Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) frameworks; Drafting parts of expert reports, memos, and deposition questions, preparing trial exhibits and preparing cross examination questions for trials.

The applicable base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $235,000 per year. The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, 401K savings and other retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.
